findings.summary: The new os.Chmod changes the mode of existing directories (e.g. "."), which can strip group/other access or fail if the process doesn't own it; MkdirAll never did this.

findings.summary: The perm argument is applied to the directory rather than the file, so a file-style mode like 0o644 makes the directory untraversable and os.Create fails for non-root users; the doc comment doesn't explain this.

judge.reason: Applying perm to the directory is the intended design; the file-mode complaint isn't the answer-key defect and is about usage, not a real bug.

findings.summary: TestSaveUploadedFileWithPermission saves to "permission_test", so it checks the package directory's mode (changed by the new Chmod) instead of the intended target, leaves the saved file behind, and never checks its contents.

judge.reason: Test saves into the package directory, asserting on a pre-existing directory's mode and leaving files behind; a real test flaw.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Test saving to a relative name makes it check the package directory's mode and leaves files behind; a real test flaw.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: The test really does chmod the package directory and leaves the saved file behind, so it checks the wrong target.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: TestSaveUploadedFileWithPermissionFailed depends on the environment: it expects an error from a 0o644 directory, which doesn't occur when running as root (e.g. in CI containers), and it can leave a "test" directory behind.

judge.reason: Test depends on non-root execution and can leave a directory behind; real fragility.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Test depends on non-root execution and can leave a directory behind; real fragility.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: The test fails when run as root and can leave a directory behind, so it is environment-dependent.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Test relies on non-root permissions and fails as root; real environment-dependent flakiness.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: The test really depends on the environment: running as root bypasses the permission check, so the expected error never happens.
